title: rubus vulgaris f. commutatus
intro: Rubus vulgaris f. commutatus, commonly known as Black Raspberry or Bramble, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. This plant is rich in antioxidants, vitamins, and minerals, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory properties, anti-cancer effects, and cardiovascular protection. The therapeutic actions of Rubus vulgaris f. commutatus include antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it useful in treating wounds, skin conditions, and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthocyanins, ellagic acid, and salicylic acid, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
